title: EyeArt AI compared with ophthalmologists' dilated exams for diabetic retinopathy
summary: In a prospective multicentre pivotal trial of 521 participants with a reading-center reference, EyeArt had sensitivity 96.5-97% versus 20.6% for general ophthalmologists and 59.5% for retina specialists; specificity was 86-88%, lower than the ophthalmologists'.
ai_technology: EyeArt AI detecting more-than-mild diabetic retinopathy from two-field photographs
organization: University of Illinois, Illinois Eye and Ear Infirmary, Chicago, USA

evidence.tested: Prospective multicentre pivotal trial, 521 participants, reading-center reference
evidence.unknown: Lower specificity than ophthalmologists; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: EyeArt AI detects more-than-mild diabetic retinopathy from 2-field photographs
